source_identity: Official Census/BEA monthly FT-900 full-report PDF for each 2011-01 through 2022-12 reference month. Use 143 correct official index month links plus the separately verified official-path August 2015 exception. Reuse four already archived exact PDFs.
purpose: Establish exact source-byte and report-row coverage for a Stage1-derived semiconductor export-demand information hypothesis. This is source collection only, not a strategy forward day.
new_request_rule: At most one HTTP GET for each of the 140 months without a verified local PDF. Never retry an uncertain request automatically. Stop on first HTTP, size, PDF-header or source-identity failure and preserve all receipts and bytes.
receipt_fields: HTTP status, Date, Last-Modified, ETag, Content-Type and Content-Length
exact response byte count and SHA-256
reused source path and SHA-256 where applicable
source_archive: Create one NAS archive for each completed calendar year containing its 12 exact PDF bytes; verify the archive SHA-256 on NAS before calling the year backed up. Preserve local objects even after remote verification until a scoped restore/readback passes.
stop_if: Any fixed URL fails, returns non-PDF or exceeds 4,000,000 bytes
A reused local byte hash no longer matches its frozen receipt
NAS upload or remote SHA-256 verification fails
scientific_limits: An original monthly report downloaded now is not proof of its historically first-public byte version.
A PDF URL or successful download is not proof of an Exhibit 7 semiconductor row or definition continuity; assess those separately after intake.
The 2012 end-use reclassification and later annual revisions must remain explicit; do not splice absolute levels or use a current API history as PIT.
No SOXX market outcomes, Qlib factor construction, model fit, account, order or promotion in this phase.
